text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval of the collective agreement with IATSE Local 822 for Meridian Hall.

The Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the collective bargaining agreement with IATSE Local 822 for Meridian Hall. 2. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 23, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations or employee negotiations.
